name: Pipeline chip flow
looks: A short run of rounded step chips, a word and a small mono sub-label each, builds left to right, a thin arrow drawing on between each pair as it lands. Once the line is built, a subset of chips swaps to an active fill colour and a one-line caption clips in beneath to name what changed.
build: Chips are DOM cards in a flex row, each popping in on scale 0.92->1, opacity 0->1, power3.out, staggered 0.12-0.18s left to right; the connecting arrow between chips draws on (strokeDashoffset or scaleX) right after the earlier chip lands; the active-state swap recolours fill/border on power2.inOut under 0.3s; the caption clips in via a collapsing clip-path inset just after.
prompt: Build a short run of step chips left to right, a thin arrow drawing on between each pair as it lands. Once the line is built, swap the completed steps to an active colour and clip in a one-line caption beneath naming what just changed.
